gancho: Leí su celular a medianoche y…
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). Lucía wakes up as her husband's phone buzzes on the nightstand. Ricardo sleeps. She picks it up and reads, worried. Lucía whispers: "«¿Ya le dijiste?»… ¿Decirme qué?"

Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). The phone buzzes again. Lucía reads the new message, her eyes widening in the blue light. Lucía whispers: "«Ella no puede enterarse antes del sábado»…"

Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). Lucía turns on the bedside lamp and shakes Ricardo awake. Lucía says: "Ricardo, despierta. ¿Quién es Mónica?"

Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). Ricardo sits up sleepily, sees the phone in her hand and panics, reaching for it. Ricardo says: "Lucía, dame eso. No es lo que piensas."

Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). Lucía holds the phone away, tears in her eyes. Lucía says: "¿Qué no puedo saber antes del sábado, Ricardo?"

Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). Ricardo sighs, opens the nightstand drawer and takes out a small wrapped gift box. Ricardo says: "Mónica es la organizadora… de tu fiesta sorpresa."

Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). Lucía opens the box and finds a party invitation with her photo and a big number 40. She covers her mouth. Lucía says: "¿Mis cuarenta? ¿Una fiesta para mí?"

Dark bedroom at night, lit only by a phone screen and later a bedside lamp. Characters: LUCÍA (39, wavy brown hair, grey pajamas), RICARDO (41, short beard, white t-shirt). Ricardo smiles, exhausted. Lucía laughs through tears and hugs him tightly. Ricardo says: "Tres meses planeándola… y la acabas de arruinar."
